segments.zh: 是的，所以这实际上是一个非常有用的短语。

segments.en: It can help you sound really native-like so why don't we hear some examples of how it's used.
segments.zh: 它能帮你听起来像母语者，那我们来听几个用法示例。

segments.en: Example one.
segments.zh: 例句一。

segments.en: As you can see, we recently remodeled our entire kitchen.
segments.zh: 如您所见，我们最近对整个厨房进行了改造。

segments.en: Example two.
segments.zh: 例句二。

segments.en: As you can see here, the damage to the building is very serious.
segments.zh: 正如您在这里看到的，对建筑物的破坏非常严重。

segments.en: Example three.
segments.zh: 例句三。

segments.en: As you can see, the hair stylist made a mistake when cutting my hair.
segments.zh: 如您所见，发型师在剪头发时犯了一个错误。

segments.en: Alright great, so as you can see.
segments.zh: 好吧，正如你所见。

segments.en: Now for our second phrase, well Tiger Woods wasn't doing very well and the announcer said it's not his day.
segments.zh: 现在看第二个短语。老虎·伍兹打得不太好，解说员说他今天不顺。

segments.en: It's not his day.
segments.zh: 今天不是他的好日子。

segments.en: It's not his day today.
segments.zh: 今天不是他的好日子。

segments.en: Alright, so when it's not your day, you're having a bad time or a bad day.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以当今天不是你的好日子时，你就是运气不好、过得不顺。

segments.en: Right, maybe you're having difficulties or you're having bad luck that day.
segments.zh: 对，也许你有困难，或者你那天运气不好。

segments.en: Yeah, so for example, today I had a headache and I ripped my pants and I spilled coffee on myself so it really wasn't my day.
segments.zh: 是的，比如今天我头疼、裤子撕了、咖啡又洒到自己身上，所以今天真的不是我的好日子。

segments.en: Okay, it's not your day today.
segments.zh: 好吧，今天不是你的好日子。

segments.en: No.
segments.zh: 不。

segments.en: Great phrase and also very common and makes you sound very native.
segments.zh: 很棒的短语，也很常见，能让你听起来像母语者。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Now the last phrase, similar to it's not your day, we also heard that Tiger was having a hard time.
segments.zh: 最后一句，和“今天不是你的好日子”类似，我们还听到老虎很吃力。

segments.en: Okay, to have a hard time.
segments.zh: 好吧，to have a hard time。

segments.en: To have a hard time.
segments.zh: 遇到困难；很吃力。

segments.en: Now if you have a hard time with something.
segments.zh: 如果你对某件事很吃力。

segments.en: You have difficulty with it.
segments.zh: 你有困难。

segments.en: Okay, now it's not only related to golf, right?
segments.zh: 好吧，现在它不仅与高尔夫有关，对吧？

segments.en: Of course, you can talk about anything like this.
segments.zh: 当然，你可以谈论这样的事情。

segments.en: So I'm having a hard time understanding what this word means.
segments.zh: 所以我很难理解这个词的意思。

segments.en: Okay, or when I was in school, I had a hard time with math.
segments.zh: 好吧，或者当我在学校的时候，我在数学上遇到了困难。

segments.en: Alright, me too.
segments.zh: 好吧，我也是。

segments.en: So to have a hard time means that you have difficulties with something.
segments.zh: 所以 have a hard time 的意思就是做某事有困难。

segments.en: So great phrases, great words.
segments.zh: 这么棒的短语，很棒的单词。

segments.en: Let's listen to this dialogue for the last time and then we'll come back and talk a little bit more about golf.
segments.zh: 让我们最后一次听听这个对话，然后我们会回来多谈谈高尔夫。

segments.en: Good morning, Golf Aficionados.
segments.zh: 早上好，高尔夫球迷。

segments.en: My name is Rick Fields and you guessed it.
segments.zh: 我的名字是 Rick Fields，你猜对了。

segments.en: I'm here with my main man, Bob Copeland.
segments.zh: 今天和我一起的是我的老搭档鲍勃·科普兰。

segments.en: Thank you, Rick.
segments.zh: 谢谢你，Rick。

segments.en: As you can see, ladies and gentlemen, we are here in beautiful Pebble Beach where the top golfers in the world are vying to win the grand prize of $1 million.
segments.zh: 女士们先生们，我们来到风景优美的圆石滩，世界顶尖球手将在这里争夺一百万美元大奖。

segments.en: Whoa, that's a lot of cash.
segments.zh: 哇，这真是一大笔钱。

segments.en: Let's go to the course and see how Tiger Woods is doing.
segments.zh: 现在转到球场，看看泰格·伍兹表现如何。

segments.en: All right, we're here at the eighth hole.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们在第八洞。

segments.en: It's par four and has some very difficult hazards which many golfers find difficult to avoid.
segments.zh: 这是四杆洞，有几个非常棘手的障碍区，许多球手都很难避开。

segments.en: Although, I did see Jack Niclaus hit a hole at one on this very same hole.
segments.zh: 不过，我确实见过杰克·尼克劳斯就在这个洞打出一杆进洞。

segments.en: Tiger Woods is about to tee off and let's see if he has the same luck as Jack.
segments.zh: 泰格·伍兹正准备开球，看看他能否像杰克一样走运。

segments.en: Tiger is asking his caddy for his driver and he seems to be very nervous.
segments.zh: 泰格向球童要来一号木杆，看起来有些紧张。

segments.en: Oh no, not a good swing at all.
segments.zh: 哦不，这一杆挥得真差。

segments.en: It's definitely not his day today.
segments.zh: 今天显然不是他的好日子。

segments.en: On the seventh hole, he got a bogey and before that he barely made par.
segments.zh: 第七洞他打了个柏忌，在那之前也只是勉强保住标准杆。

segments.en: He will definitely not get a birdie on this shot.
segments.zh: 这一杆他肯定打不出小鸟球。

segments.en: It seems that his ball has flown somewhere deep into the trees.
segments.zh: 球似乎飞进了树林深处。

segments.en: He's having a hard time finding it and even his caddy has climbed a tree to try and spot it.
segments.zh: 他找了半天，连球童都爬上树找球了。

segments.en: Oh no, a bear.
segments.zh: 哦不，一只熊。

segments.en: Run, Tiger, run.
segments.zh: 跑，老虎，跑。

segments.en: Somebody call animal control.
segments.zh: 快叫野生动物管理部门！

segments.en: All right, so Marco, I know that in the Western business world, golf is actually super important for your career, isn't it?
segments.zh: 好吧，马可，我知道在西方商业世界，高尔夫对你的职业生涯来说实际上是非常重要的，不是吗？

segments.en: Well, many times when you see in movies or the stereotype is that business is done on a golf course.
segments.zh: 好吧，很多时候你在电影里看到的，或者说那种刻板印象，就是生意是在高尔夫球场上谈成的。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: And yeah, it is true.
segments.zh: 是的，这是真的。

segments.en: Many times, you know people will invite you out to a golf course and you'll be playing a game and talking business and relaxing at the same time.
segments.zh: 很多时候，你知道人们会邀请你去一个高尔夫球场，你会玩游戏、谈论生意和放松。

segments.en: So maybe you negotiate a deal out on the golf course.
segments.zh: 所以也许你在高尔夫球场谈判达成协议。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: And of course, if you lose, it's a good thing because then the deal will pull through.
segments.zh: 当然，如果你输了，这是一件好事，因为那样交易就会成功。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Well, actually, I know that it is so important for people who are wanting to do well in business and many people who don't speak English as their first language take golf English lessons.
segments.zh: 好吧，实际上，我知道对于那些想要在商业上取得好成绩的人来说，这非常重要，而且许多不以英语为第一语言的人上高尔夫英语课。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So not only golf lessons, like how to play golf, but also in English.
segments.zh: 所以不仅仅是高尔夫课，比如打高尔夫球，还有英语。

segments.en: Like how to talk about golf, how to talk to other people and make deals while you're on the golf course.
segments.zh: 比如如何谈论高尔夫、如何在高尔夫球场上与他人交谈并进行交易。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Because like in many other sports, golf has also its slang and its terms and stuff.
segments.zh: 因为和许多其他运动一样，高尔夫也有自己的俚语、术语之类的。

segments.en: So yeah, it's very interesting and it's one of those cultural things.
segments.zh: 所以，是的，这很有趣，而且是这些文化事物之一。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So if you have any questions or comments about today's lesson, why don't you visit our website at EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 因此，如果您对今天的课程有任何疑问或意见，为什么不访问我们的网站 englishpod.com。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: We're always there to answer any questions or doubts you might have.
segments.zh: 我们随时为您解答任何问题或疑问。

segments.en: And until next time, we'll see you there.
segments.zh: 直到下一次，我们会在那里见到你。

segments.en: Goodbye.
segments.zh: 再见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
